slice: Logical partition statement identity, retained outcome observation, descriptor epoch and shared value encodings; no cross-version disk or mixed-node compatibility

rows.owner: Service Cell entry generator and service compiler composition
rows.observation: The generator contains service-cell-v2 operation-ID dispatch; older execution prose describes the earlier single-operation entry. The default cutover Quest is recorded solved, but Q0 did not replay that public witness.
rows.limitation: Source dispatch and historical Quest proof are not an original public-path receipt on this Q0 baseline.
rows.nextProof: Service Q5 owner must pin the default compiler and complete generate-build-deploy-call witness, including inverse ABI refusal.

rows.owner: Request Cell invocation and bounded nested host-call bridge
rows.observation: The request bridge admits sequential calls with one outstanding and depth one; its default budget is 16, distinct from the raw protocol default of one nested call.
rows.limitation: The scoped source read establishes two distinct default domains; it does not certify every production call path or published user reference.
rows.nextProof: Q5 must specify budget and depth per entry path and rerun nested-call producer-to-consumer public witnesses.

rows.owner: Call Cell canonical partial codec and reduce coordinator
rows.observation: The owned lagrange.partial.v1 codec accepts bounded finite JSON and rejects unsafe integers, noncanonical bytes and malformed Unicode; older numeric-only prose is narrower.
rows.limitation: Codec functions and built-in examples are not independent decoder agreement or a deployed emit-to-reduce receipt.
rows.nextProof: Q1 should derive independent representation vectors; Q5 must prove emit/reduce end-to-end through real Call Cell entry.

rows.owner: Request Cell invocation lifetime and worker cancellation owner
rows.observation: Waiter detachment, last-waiter abort and uncertain durable-effect outcomes exist; the native SQLite interrupt continuation remains separately unsealed.
rows.limitation: Cancelling a caller wait must not be confused with aborting native work, reversing a Raft commit or settling its effect.
rows.nextProof: Q5 cancellation owner must state and test detached-wait, dispatched-work and committed-effect outcomes separately.

rows.owner: MessageRouter startup composition and transport trust provider
rows.observation: Conditional TLS code exists while current-capabilities states trusted-network plaintext WebSocket; support-envelope names a version-qualified mTLS target.
rows.limitation: No production ClusterTrustProvider construction was found in the bounded src search; code presence does not establish mTLS integration.
rows.nextProof: Transport owner must pin version pair, constructor wiring, public startup and original source-bound security drill before claiming mTLS.

rows.owner: WIT guest ABI and Host binding-call error code registry
rows.observation: The binding-call-error record calls code a closed set but delegates the actual vocabulary to a JavaScript host constant outside WIT.
rows.limitation: The ABI alone cannot reproduce the exact admitted and refused codes without reading production source.
rows.nextProof: Q5 ABI owner must place the complete versioned error registry and inverse conformance vectors at the public interface.

rows.owner: Core-system logic model and subsystem-specific proof owners
rows.observation: The core-system model explicitly limits itself to a low-resolution owner skeleton and delegates protocol details to subsystem models.
rows.resolution: Classify this as a documented proof-scope ceiling, not as a contradiction requiring a new global model.
rows.limitation: A model census does not prove full write, recovery, topology or CDC protocol behavior.
rows.nextProof: Q2-Q4 should select owner-specific counterexamples and compose existing models at their actual boundaries.

rows.owner: Partition snapshot checkpoint and retained SQLite/Raft storage owners
rows.observation: Rebalance prose refers to source implementations for checkpoint and log layouts; it is not a complete standalone portable binary format specification.
rows.limitation: Behavioral equivalence is the approved goal; on-disk migration and mixed-node byte compatibility are explicitly not authorized.
rows.nextProof: Q2 must specify logical recovery and commit invariants; physical interoperability needs a separate user scope decision.

rows.owner: Core convergence integration and original rs-raft cutover Quest
rows.observation: The epic explicitly labels older Liferaft defaults as historical and calls for a fresh readiness census before behavior-changing convergence.
rows.resolution: Retain this historical cutover observation as history, not a newly observed active backend defect.
rows.limitation: The portability Q0 Quest does not satisfy or supersede the independent rs-raft readiness or release certification gates.
rows.nextProof: Integration owner must inspect the cutover predecessor and current readiness proof before authorizing runtime convergence.

rows.owner: Partition committed-statement result and retained-outcome row owner
rows.observation: Entry identity is a nonempty string, durable key is entry:<entryId>, retained census emits logIndex and term as decimal text, and optional result fields use null to mean no retained fact.
rows.limitation: The source has code-path conversions to Number elsewhere; no cross-language bounded integer grammar or public replay witness was specified here.
rows.nextProof: Q1 must define exact decimal and absent-value representation vectors; Q2 must prove replay/commit boundaries through a cold restart.

rows.owner: Native committed membership and permanent learner-origin context owner
rows.observation: The authoritative committed entry index and term are exact canonical decimal strings; immutable operation and transition identifiers are distinct from a later native execution attempt.
rows.limitation: The owner contract does not enumerate the portable lexical/overflow refusal set or an independent decimal decoder.
rows.nextProof: Q1 must produce accepted and inverse rejected 64-bit decimal vectors while retaining distinct index, term, generation and identity domains.

rows.owner: Partition descriptor epoch routing and split/merge cutover owner
rows.observation: Routing requires exact descriptor partition_version equality; a normalizer converts inputs through JS Number and accepts positive integers.
rows.limitation: JS Number admits imprecise large integer inputs and multiple input spellings; these are not yet an approved portable wire grammar.
rows.nextProof: Q1 must define an explicit epoch domain and strict cross-language comparison subset; any changed production admission belongs to a later behavior Quest.

rows.owner: HLC timestamp encoding and comparison owner
rows.observation: The HLC uses physical-logical-node text with dash-delimited node ID, parseInt lexical acceptance and localeCompare for node tie-breaking.
rows.limitation: Parsing permits trailing junk and comparison may depend on locale; no portable full-domain HLC order can be promised from these observations.
rows.nextProof: Q1 must set a normative unambiguous admitted subset and negative tests; HLC owner must separately resolve lax-parse/locale ordering before declaring full-port conformance.

rows.owner: Call Cell finite-JSON partial codec owner
rows.observation: Owned codec defines UTF-16 code-unit key sorting, finite JSON, negative-zero normalization, limits and a versioned partial envelope.
rows.limitation: The module's JavaScript golden examples are neither standalone normative cases nor independent language decoding evidence.
rows.nextProof: Q1 must publish exact valid/invalid vectors and compare them using an implementation that imports no runtime decision modules.

rows.owner: Partition retained observation and shared explicit absence contracts
rows.observation: The authority contract distinguishes a durable fact, local projection, absent fact and unavailable owner, while committed-statement reads distinguish UNSETTLED from settled rows.
rows.limitation: No selected-slice portable tagged union yet distinguishes absent, unavailable and unresolved-unknown without abusing null.
rows.nextProof: Q1 must define tagged outcomes for the selected logical observations with negative controls for absent-as-zero and unknown-as-failure.

rows.owner: PartitionService raft proposal, commit acknowledgment and recovery owner
rows.observation: The write path has owned Raft commit and settled-result logic, separate from the read-only retained-outcome census.
rows.limitation: Q0 did not execute CREATE TABLE/write/crash/reopen, exact-source three-node evidence or storage-failure experiments.
rows.nextProof: Q2 must enumerate crash points and prove committed-before-ack, replay idempotency, unknown reply and recovery on its original source.
